shields_note: Posted 'fear is my ally' among the Effects; the strategy says 'pick whatever shields you like, i suggest battle order, grabber and oppressive number among them', but no shields are listed.
notes: Posted 25 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

No Objective. Starting cards as posted under 'Start5': Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (posted 'japan 5th marker'), Prepared Defenses, Prepare For A Surface Attack, You May Start Your Landing ('ymsyl') and Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans ('combo arrest order'); Fear Is My Ally is posted among the Effects. All count toward the 60.
Section headers with counts ('locations6', 'admirals orders4', 'FX9', etc.) are not cards.

The author calls Hoth 'japan' as a joke: 'japan 3rd marker' dested Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker); 'japan tokyo airport db' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay; 'japan system' Hoth; 'foil jap imperial walker' Imperial Walker; 'foil japanese trample' Trample.
Posted 'suicide vader x2' is printed as written: several Darth Vader cards fit and the post does not say which.

Posted 'admiral chirac' dested Admiral Chiraneau; 'GMT' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'commander ... AKA Lord Merrejek' Commander Merrejk; 'executordb' Executor: Docking Bay; 'bliz 1/2/4' Blizzard 1/2/4; 'chimaira' Chimaera; 'thunderfart' Thunderflare; 'revenger' Avenger; 'ZiMH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'DiP1' Dengar In Punishing One; 'combo box' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Rebel btch occupation' Rebel Base Occupation; 'lateralus damage' Lateral Damage.
Posted 'oldskool code clearance' dested the Coruscant Effect Do They Have A Code Clearance?, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield (the strategy says not to use the shield Code Clearance).
Posted 'battle deployment x2' and 'foil battle deployment' are combined as 3 Battle Deployment; 'foil twilek advisor x2' counted as 2.

Byline 'Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag' looks like a joke name (Geburtstag is German for birthday; the post is signed 'giles'), so the deck is credited to the handle .prototype. with no player page, as with deck 19965.
